ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row OppVR83] Blocks field edits while Stage = Closed. Per IRM correction: restricted to users with the 'Sales & Account Management' profile only. ISCHANGED(LastModifiedDate), gated by Disable_VR__c so flows/integrations toggle that setting instead.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR( ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity') )),
ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed'),
$Profile.Name = 'Sales & Account Management',
ISCHANGED(LastModifiedDate) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Insufficient permissions. Opportunities in Closed stage cannot be updated. Please contact your regional Sales Operations Business Partner for assistance.
